title: Marketplace Briefing Cheatsheet — Priya
content:
Purpose: quick prep / cheat sheet for partner marketplace syncs. Lightweight, shareable after the call, keep to <30 min when possible.

Meeting context
- Partner: NimbusCloud (AWS + GCP reseller) — enthusiastic but needs clarity on listing steps + cost model.
- Meeting type: intro + technical onboarding + commercial alignment (internal: growth lead present).
- Goal: leave with a clear 3-step plan (tech ready, listing assets, commercial ask).

Agenda (30 min recommended)
1) 5m quick intros + mutual success metric (what does a win look like in 60 days?)
2) 10m technical checklist + timeline (what we need to list on each marketplace)
3) 8m commercial / GTM ask (credits, co-marketing, revenue share expectations)
4) 5m next steps + confirm owners / dates

Quick intros script (Priya)
- 20s: Redwood Inference mission + why marketplace matters (developer-first inference + production reliability).
- 20s: what NimbusCloud brings (channel reach + managed infra).
- 20s: immediate ask for call: confirm who will own AMI/packaging + who signs the marketplace listing form.

Technical checklist (to run through live)
- Model package artifacts: delivery format (container image vs AMI vs OCI bundle) — confirm partner preference.
- IAM roles & permissions: who will assume deployment role? provide sample IAM policy snippet during call.
- Acceptable instance families for testing (we recommend g4dn / a2 series for perf baseline) — ask partner's dev account quotas.
- Telemetry & billing: do we expose usage metrics to partner? need to confirm observability integration (CloudWatch / Stackdriver / Azure Monitor).
- Listing metadata: short description (1-liner), technical requirements, supported regions, pricing link.
- Packaging checklist: container (Dockerfile + entrypoint), manifest (model name/version/quantization), sample inference request + latency baseline.
- Security requirements: data-in-transit, KMS key access if private images, SLA expectations.

Demo outline (if partner asks for live demo)
- 3m: quick generation demo using hosted Redwood API to show latency & token cost tradeoff.
- 3m: show packaging repo layout (README, Dockerfile, manifest).
- 2m: show marketplace listing preview (draft copy). Keep technical depth light — focus on “what we'll deliver”.

Commercial / GTM ask (frame as collaborative)
- Ask A: 3 months free dev credits for partner engineers to test + one sandbox account pre-provisioned.
- Ask B: co-marketing: 1 blog post + joint webinar in Q4.
- Ask C: revenue share baseline or referral fee — flag legal to draft initial T&Cs.
- Internal note: escalate to Lina for pricing carve-outs; Ethan to own sandbox provisioning.

Risks / open questions (call out during meeting)
- Listing timeline vs partner procurement cycles — may need flexible staging.
- Region parity for tokenized billing (AWS us-east vs partner region).
- Any regulatory constraints for customer data in partner-managed deployments? ask for customer examples.
- Marketplace item classification: SaaS vs AMI vs Private Listing — which lane does Nimbus prefer?

Action items (post-call template)
- Priya: send meeting notes + 3-step plan within 24h (include timelines, owners).
- Ethan: create sandbox dev account + seed with 50k tokens by EOD+2 days.
- Lina: draft co-marketing outline + draft one-pager for partner marketing by EOD+5 days.
- Nimbus (Partner): confirm packaging preference (container/AMI/OCI) and provide contact for procurement.
- Legal (cc later): prepare light-term sheet for listing (target within 10 business days).

Ownership matrix (quick)
- Technical packaging owner: Nimbus dev lead (ask for name during call) — backup: Ethan Morales.
- Sandbox & billing owner: Ethan Morales.
- Marketing / PR: Lina Gomez.
- Contract / marketplace T&Cs: Legal / Priya to loop.

Prep notes for tone / negotiation
- Be collaborative, not prescriptive. Offer Redwood-managed packaging support for first listing to remove friction.
- If partner pushes long exclusivity ask — push back: prefer non-exclusive, shorter-term pilots.
- Keep deadlines soft but set clear checkpoints at 7 / 14 / 30 days.

Snippets to paste in follow-up email (copy/paste friendly)
- "Thanks for the time today — next steps: 1) confirm packaging preference, 2) confirm sandbox contact, 3) expect our draft listing copy in 48hrs. Priya (Redwood) / Ethan (sandbox) / Lina (co-marketing) will own the initial work."
- Attachment checklist we will send: packaging template repo link, sample IAM policy, draft listing copy, sandbox access instructions.

Personal TODOs (scratch)
- Find lightweight IAM sample (from infra team) to paste into email. (ask @raj in #platform-infra)
- Prep 1-slide marketplace one-pager to share post-call.
- Add a small latency-cost table: gpt-medium -> tokens/sec / $ per 1k tokens (estimate).

Unresolved (flag in doc)
- Partner procurement lead name?? (ask at start)
- Do they require private listing vs public? (impact timeline heavily)

Endnote: after meeting, edit this doc into a 1-page digest for partner and stash in shared drive under shared_drives/company/partner-collabs for cross-team visibility.

-- Priya (quick scribbles)
